final: WITH g AS (SELECT e.link_to_budget AS bid, b.event_status AS status, AVG(e.cost) AS grp_avg FROM expense e JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY e.link_to_budget, b.event_status), o AS (SELECT AVG(grp_avg) AS overall FROM g) SELECT g.status, AVG(g.grp_avg), AVG(g.grp_avg - o.overall) FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE g.grp_avg > o.overall GROUP BY g.status ORDER BY g.status
